note: The repository bundles CSV inputs, predictions, gains, and parameter fixtures used by examples/tests. They are treated as bundled test/example data rather than a standalone research dataset.

The root README states that datasets contained in the Google Research monorepo are released under CC BY 4.0, while source files are Apache-2.0. Dataset contents are project-specific and were not recursively normalized in Stage 2.

The repository bundles demonstration/reproduction notebooks, while static inspection of the model-inference notebook shows evaluation NetCDF datasets and model checkpoints are copied from gs://gresearch/jax-cfd public Google Cloud Storage locations rather than bundled in the repository.
